legalCitations.description: PRESCRIPTIVE STATUTORY FORM - Utah has minimal flexibility in affidavit format, requires sentence case for 'State of Utah'
Notary commission requirements including expiration date
Perjury statute - false sworn statement is perjury under Utah criminal code
Requirements for affidavits in summary judgment - must show affiant is competent to testify

affidavitJurat:
Subscribed and sworn to before me, ________________________________,
                                    (notary public name)

on this _______ day of _________________, in the year _______,
        (date)          (month)                      (year)

by ________________________________.
    (name of document signer)


(SEAL)                              _________________________________
                                    Notary Public, State of Utah

My commission expires: ___________

exhibitRules.instructions: Exhibits should be labeled with letters (A, B, C, etc.). Cover pages are recommended for clarity.
